component.name: Roblox Vault
component.summary: Store, design, preview and sync your Roblox systems

description.p: Roblox Vault keeps each of your Roblox systems (an inventory, a shop, a quest log) as its own project with server, client and shared scripts, GUIs and notes, and live-syncs them into Roblox Studio with Rojo.

ul.li: GUI preview on desktop, laptop, tablet and phone screen sizes
Figma tab: design a frame, import it as a Roblox ScreenGui, update it later
Live sync to Roblox Studio, or build a place file
No account, no ads, no tracking; everything stays on your computer

description.p: Not affiliated with or endorsed by Roblox Corporation or Figma, Inc.

ul.li: Projects with scripts, GUIs and notes, synced to Studio with Rojo
Figma tab with one-click GUI import and updates
GUI preview at four screen sizes
Uninstall button that removes the app and all its data
